paite: Huan Israel suante omkhawm Sin gamdai a pan azin ua, TOUPA thupiak bang a azin nung un Rephidim ah apuanin uh akai uhi. Huai ah mite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
heading: Suangpi A Pan Tui / (Nam 20.1-13)

paite: Huaiziak in mite'n Mosi akinakpih ua, "Ka dawn ding uh tui hon pia in," achi uhi. Mosi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon kinakpih na hi ua? Bangziak a TOUPA ze-et na hi ua?" achi hi.
Mite lah tui duh in huai ah adang uh atak a; Mosi tung ah mite aphun ua, "Dangtakna a kou leh ka tate uh leh ka gante uh hon that dia, bangziak a Aigupta gam a pan hon lakhia na hia?" achi uhi.
TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akap a, "Hiai mite bang ka loh dia? Suang a hon denglum ding in mansa in a-om uhi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite ma ah pai inla, Israel upate tonpih inla; lui na satna chiang na khut in tawi inla, pai in.

Ngai in, Horeb ah suangpi tung ah na ma ah ka dingh ding a, suangpi na sat dia, huai a pan tui ahong pawtkhe ding, mite'n adawntheihna ding un," achi hi. Israel upate muh in Mosi in huchibang in ahihta hi.
Huai mun min Massah leh Meribah asa hi, Israel suante'n TOUPA tawng a, amah chian in, "I lak uah TOUPA a-om hia, om lou," achih ziak un.
Huai khit in Amalek ahong kuan a, Rephidim ah Israelte ahong dou hi.
heading: Amalek Toh Kidouna

paite: Mosi in Joshua kiang ah, “Mi hon telkhia inla, pawtkhe ni in, Amalek i dou ding. Zingchiang in ka khut a Pathian' chiangkhun tawi in mualvum ah ka kuan ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in akiang a, agen bang in Joshua in ahih a, Amalek adou uhi. Mosi leh Aaron leh Hur mualvum ah ahohtouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in akhut aliktouh chiang in, Israelte ahat ua; akhut akhiaksuk chiang in, Amalek ahat hi.

Himahleh Mosi khut agik a; huchi in suang ala ua, anuai ah akoih uhi. Huai tung ah amah atu a, Aaron leh Hur in akhut adoptouhsak uhi; khat in akhat lam pang, leh adang pen in akhat lam pang ah. Huchi in nitum matan akhutte apangzou hi.
Huchi in Joshua in Amalek leh amite anamsau in azouta hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Theihgige ding in hiai laibu ah gelh inla, Joshua bil ah gen nawn in. Van nuai a pan Amalek theihgigena ka koihmang sipsip ding ziak in," achi hi.
Mosi in huai ah maitam adoh a, amin Jehovah-nissi asa hi.
"Akhang akhang a TOUPA'N Amalek dou gige ding chi a akichiam ziak in,” achi hi.
